items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names and doc comments are mostly clear, but formatting drifts: new blank lines at EOF in encode.go, lax_polyline.go and point_vector.go (gofmt would flag these). Existing TODO comments were deleted for no reason, e.g. 'LaxClosedPolyline/VertexIDLaxLoop' in lax_loop.go.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Ignores the convention of a dedicated shapeindex_encode.go: Encode/Decode were appended to shapeindex.go instead. Unrelated work is mixed in (removeShapeInternal, tracker.lowerBound, iterator changes in shrinkToFit/updateEdges). Large commit; ShapeIndex decode is long and monolithic.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Every length is checked against a limit before allocating (maxEncodedVertices, maxEncodedLoops, plus the new named maxShapeIndex*/maxClippedShapesPerCell constants). Errors propagate through d.err, read loops exit early on error, and the nil writer/reader, unknown tags and negative nextID are all rejected.

items.name: Existing encodings and Shape interface unchanged
items.name_zh: 既有编码格式与 Shape 接口不变
items.evidence: Adds typeTagLoop=6 and typeTagLaxLoop=7 after the existing tags without renumbering any. The Polyline/Loop/Polygon wire formats are unchanged; Polyline.decode only switches to a pointer receiver. Shape interface untouched; encodableShape is unexported.
